purpose: Prepare bounded report-only checks for silent workspace, plugin and synchronization failures after local or scripted Obsidian workspace changes.

prior_art.classification: operational prior art only; not a Pantheon dependency or authority

post_mutation_posture.required_result: findings with exact observed paths/device/plugin/sync context when available

cases.observed_condition: a note is moved or archived while live notes still contain inbound wikilinks to the previous target
forbidden_effects: auto-relink every inbound reference
auto-delete dangling references
infer one universal archive-link policy
treat the finding as a confirmed professional defect

cases.observed_condition: one scalar frontmatter value appears to contain multiple wikilink targets
required_observations: local schema expectation when one exists
forbidden_effects: rewrite the property automatically
invent a schema when none is owned
create missing notes from malformed link text

cases.observed_condition: a metadata timestamp changes without attributable content-edit provenance and may have been written by a plugin or linter
forbidden_effects: treat the metadata timestamp as proof of a human-authored edit
rewrite historical timestamps automatically
promote plugin output to source truth

cases.observed_condition: synced plugin configuration appears correct but observed behavior differs on one device
required_observations: device identity sufficient for the test
forbidden_effects: assume synced configuration proves effective device state
change every device automatically
classify the plugin as healthy from configuration alone

cases.observed_condition: a live file and one or more synchronization-conflict copies coexist after a configuration or note change
forbidden_effects: discard the conflict copy automatically
assume the live filename is the correct version
select a winner from modification time alone
claim convergence before the conflict is resolved and re-observed

cases.observed_condition: a scripted or bulk filesystem change succeeded locally but downstream synchronization has not been re-observed
required_observations: rescan or convergence observation when the selected mechanism supports it
forbidden_effects: claim sync success from local filesystem success
start a second synchronization producer
treat a rescan request as professional approval

cases.observed_condition: a file outside the vault stores a direct pointer to a vault leaf that was renamed or moved
forbidden_effects: rewrite files outside the authorized scope automatically
infer governed identity from the old or new path
treat pointer repair as authorization for the underlying workspace mutation

execution_gate.required_before_observed_result: run each selected case against an isolated or explicitly authorized workspace/device/sync setup and retain exact observed evidence
execution_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not convert the prepared expectations in this fixture into claims that Pantheon, Obsidian, plugins or LiveSync exhibited these failures on a real deployment.
